title: EPT Benchmark: Evaluation of Persian Trustworthiness in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to a curated dataset of prompts reflecting Persian linguistic nuances and Islamic ethical principles (e.g., Islamic finance/riba, culturally sensitive moral dilemmas), using a hybrid approach of automated LLM-based scoring and native human expert reviews to assess alignment with local norms versus Western secular values.

Testing the models' decision-making and resource allocation fairness across different demographic groups, such as comparing recommendations for funding and infrastructure between urban and rural communities in Iran.

Assessing how models classify and respond to statements regarding Iranian historical identity and geopolitical realities (e.g., the historical naming of the Persian Gulf and ancient civilizations) to detect unwarranted stereotyping or disparagement.
